title: contextator chart values
description: Strict (ADR-0092): every object level rejects keys it does not list, every scalar has a type and closed value sets are enums, so a misspelt or mistyped value fails helm install/upgrade/template instead of being ignored. Structures Kubernetes leaves open are bounded by their type only. There is no replicaCount entry: the chart does not offer the key at all (ADR-0078), so setting it fails as an unknown key. Draft-07 because Helm v3 validates with gojsonschema, which supports drafts 4, 6 and 7 only.

stringMap.description: A string-to-string map (annotations, labels, nodeSelector). Open: any key is accepted.

openObject.description: A Kubernetes structure the chart passes through as written (resources, affinity, security contexts). Bounded by its type only.

openArray.description: A Kubernetes list the chart passes through as written (tolerations, extra volumes and mounts). Bounded by its type only.

storageClassName.description: Empty uses the cluster's default StorageClass.

existingClaim.description: Name of a PersistentVolumeClaim to mount instead of creating one. Empty creates the chart's own.

global.description: Not used by this chart. Listed because Helm hands every chart a `global` map when it is installed as a subchart, and a strict root would otherwise reject it.

tag.description: Required, a `-slim` tag. A string, so a numeric-looking tag needs --set-string. Emptiness is checked by the template, whose error explains what to set (ADR-0078).

database.description: Required: `url` or `existingSecret` must be non-empty. The template checks that and says which to set (ADR-0078).

trustProxy.description: TRUST_PROXY. Empty leaves it unset (the app's default, off); never inferred from ingress.enabled (ADR-0060).

confluenceAllowedHosts.description: CONFLUENCE_ALLOWED_HOSTS: host names or IP addresses (not URLs: no scheme, port or path) a Confluence source may reach on a private address (ADR-0088). Mirrors the application's startup check (src/config.ts): a DNS-style name (letters, digits, '_' and inner '-', optional trailing dot) or an IP address, IPv6 optionally in brackets. Empty leaves it unset.

anyOf.description: A host name or an IPv4 address, e.g. wiki.corp.example or 10.0.4.12.
An IPv6 address (at least two colons), bare or in brackets, e.g. fd00::12 or [fd00::12]. A port after the brackets, or an IPv4 address with a port, is rejected.

webAllowedHosts.description: WEB_ALLOWED_HOSTS: host names or IP addresses (not URLs: no scheme, port or path) a web source may reach on a private address (ADR-0107). Mirrors the application's startup check (src/config.ts): a DNS-style name (letters, digits, '_' and inner '-', optional trailing dot) or an IP address, IPv6 optionally in brackets. Empty leaves it unset.

anyOf.description: A host name or an IPv4 address, e.g. wiki.corp.example or 10.0.4.12.
An IPv6 address (at least two colons), bare or in brackets, e.g. fd00::12 or [fd00::12]. A port after the brackets, or an IPv4 address with a port, is rejected.

gitAllowedHosts.description: GIT_ALLOWED_HOSTS: host names or IP addresses (not URLs: no scheme, port or path) a git source may reach on a private address (ADR-0107). Mirrors the application's startup check (src/config.ts): a DNS-style name (letters, digits, '_' and inner '-', optional trailing dot) or an IP address, IPv6 optionally in brackets. Empty leaves it unset.

anyOf.description: A host name or an IPv4 address, e.g. wiki.corp.example or 10.0.4.12.
An IPv6 address (at least two colons), bare or in brackets, e.g. fd00::12 or [fd00::12]. A port after the brackets, or an IPv4 address with a port, is rejected.

gitMaxPackBytes.description: GIT_MAX_PACK_BYTES: the most bytes one response from a git remote (ref advertisement or packfile) may carry; isomorphic-git holds a packfile in memory and copies it twice, so memory peaks at about twice this value; raise it together with resources.limits.memory. At least 1048576 (1 MiB). Null or unset leaves the application default, 268435456 (256 MiB).

projectMaxDocuments.description: PROJECT_MAX_DOCUMENTS: the instance-wide default for how many documents one project may hold. A project's own cap overrides it; 0 on a project means unlimited. Null, unset or 0 leaves it off.

projectMaxChunks.description: PROJECT_MAX_CHUNKS: the instance-wide default for how many chunks one project may hold. A project's own cap overrides it; 0 on a project means unlimited. Null, unset or 0 leaves it off.

projectMaxUploadBytes.description: PROJECT_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES: the instance-wide default for the bytes stored for one project's upload sources. A project's own cap overrides it; 0 on a project means unlimited. Null, unset or 0 leaves it off.

mcpStructuredOutput.description: MCP_STRUCTURED_OUTPUT: true adds structuredContent beside every MCP tool's text answer. Off by default; false leaves the variable unset.

mcpRateLimitPerMinute.description: MCP_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE (ADR-0112): requests per minute one MCP token may send. Null or unset leaves the application default, 0 (no limit); 0 is no limit too.

mcpRateLimitAnonPerMinute.description: MCP_RATE_LIMIT_ANON_PER_MINUTE: requests per minute one client address may send to an open project without a valid token. Null or unset leaves the application default, 60; 0 turns the limit off.

mcpRateLimitTools.description: MCP_RATE_LIMIT_TOOLS: per-tool limits per minute and token as name=count pairs joined by commas, e.g. search_docs=30,read_document=60. Empty leaves it unset.

mcpRateLimitFailOpen.description: MCP_RATE_LIMIT_FAIL_OPEN: true (default) serves a request when the rate-limit counter is unreachable; false answers 503 instead (sets the variable to 0).

reindexOnModelChange.description: REINDEX_ON_MODEL_CHANGE: true queues one re-index at start-up for every project indexed with a different embedding model than the server runs now and that has at least one source. Off by default; false leaves the variable unset.

env.description: Plain environment variables, NAME: value. Open: any variable name is accepted; values are strings, so a number needs quoting or --set-string.

envSecret.description: Environment variables read from an existing Secret, NAME: {secretName, secretKey}. Open over names; each entry is strict.

serviceMonitor.description: Optional Prometheus Operator ServiceMonitor for GET /metrics. The bearer credential comes from envSecret.METRICS_TOKEN.

interval.description: Prometheus duration, units in descending order (y, w, d, h, m, s, ms), e.g. 30s or 1m30s. The same format the Prometheus Operator CRD accepts.

scrapeTimeout.description: Prometheus duration, same format as interval, e.g. 10s. Must not exceed interval; the chart refuses to render otherwise.

backup.description: Optional scheduled backup CronJob (ADR-0120: the application itself schedules nothing). Off by default; uploads each archive to an S3-compatible bucket and keeps the newest `keep`.

schedule.description: Cron expression with five fields, or an @-macro such as @daily.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone name (Kubernetes 1.27+). Empty leaves the field out.

keep.description: Archives kept in the bucket; the same meaning as BACKUP_KEEP.

image.description: The backup runs the full image (it carries pg_dump). Empty fields are derived from `image`.

tag.description: A string, so a numeric-looking tag needs --set-string.

stagingSizeLimit.description: A Kubernetes quantity such as 10Gi, or empty for no limit.

endpoint.description: Empty uses AWS S3. Otherwise an http(s) URL without credentials.

bucket.description: Required when backup.enabled is true; the template checks that and names what to set.
